network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host root, and only a disposable /tmp module directory writable. Tool and evidence checks make no network request.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact nine-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary from the hash-bound validator

scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero replay over the pinned shared warm dependency cache. It checks the exact statement, frozen composition, analytic terminal/root, recursive sorry closure, exact observed axioms, selected local and mathlib provenance, and a replay that is independent only of the Proof wrapper module and its olean. It grants no closure credit to unreconciled frozen internal leaf IDs and is not an empty-cache cold replay, complete TCB/provenance bundle, independently reasoned proof, distinct signed runner, accepted M0 state, or theorem completion.
